title: Replication of Crypto Theft Attack Chain on Modern Agent Frameworks: Does Context Poisoning Generalize?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether a known dangerous attack generalizes across frameworks. If it does, it proves a class-level vulnerability. If not, framework-specific defenses are sufficient. Either outcome is directly actionable for safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires setting up testnet environments and implementing attacks across multiple frameworks. LangChain and AutoGen are well-documented but the combination of crypto testnet setup plus multi-framework implementation is moderately complex for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Testing on 2-3 frameworks with a testnet sandbox is a reasonable scope, but setting up each framework plus testnet infrastructure takes time. Achievable in 30hrs if one framework is dropped.
